title: Hold a second-hand vehicle dealer's licence
what: Hold a second-hand vehicle dealer's licence before carrying on business as a dealer.

sources.title: Second-hand Vehicle Dealers Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on business, or hold himself or herself out, as a dealer unless licensed under this Act.
